#!/bin/bash

# deploy.sh
# Creates a release archive of the current directory (tar.gz),
# excluding node_modules and .git

set -e

# Get the current directory name for the archive name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")

# Generate timestamp for the archive name
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)

# Archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

echo "Creating release archive: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"

# Create the tar.gz archive, excluding node_modules and .git
tar -czf "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
    --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='.gitignore' \
    --exclude="${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
    .

echo "Archive created successfully: ${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "Archive size: $(du -h "${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables
validate_env() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local missing_vars=()

    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: Environment file '$env_file' not found!"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."

    # Read each line from .env.test
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

        # Extract the key (everything before the first =)
        local key="${line%%=*}"

        # Skip lines without an = sign
        [[ "$line" != *=* ]] && continue

        # Check if the environment variable is set
        if [[ -z "${!key:-}" ]]; then
            missing_vars+=("$key")
        fi
    done < "$env_file"

    # Report results
    if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "Error: The following required environment variables are not set:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "All required environment variables are set."
    echo
}

# Send validated config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local orchestrator_url="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"

    echo "Sending validated configuration to deployment orchestrator..."

    # Build JSON object from .env.test contents
    local json_payload="{"
    local first=true

    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

        # Skip lines without an = sign
        [[ "$line" != *=* ]] && continue

        # Extract the key and value
        local key="${line%%=*}"
        local value="${line#*=}"

        # Add comma before all but the first entry
        if [[ "$first" == "true" ]]; then
            first=false
        else
            json_payload+=","
        fi

        # Add key-value pair to JSON (properly escaped)
        json_payload+="\"$key\":\"$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')\""
    done < "$env_file"

    json_payload+="}"

    # Send POST request to orchestrator
    local http_code
    http_code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
        -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_payload" \
        "$orchestrator_url")

    if [[ "$http_code" != "200" && "$http_code" != "201" && "$http_code" != "204" ]]; then
        echo "Error: Failed to send config to orchestrator. HTTP $http_code"
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Configuration successfully sent to orchestrator for audit compliance."
    echo
}

# Run validation
validate_env

# Send config to orchestrator before deployment
send_config_to_orchestrator

# Deployment script
# Creates a release archive of the current directory, excluding node_modules and .git

    --exclude='.git' \

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script that creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e

# Configuration
ARCHIVE_NAME="release-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz"
SOURCE_DIR="."

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Function to print colored messages
print_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

print_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

# Main deployment function
deploy() {
    print_info "Starting deployment process..."
    
    # Check if tar is available
    if ! command -v tar &> /dev/null; then
        print_error "tar command not found. Please install tar."
        exit 1
    fi

    # Create the archive, excluding node_modules and .git
    print_info "Creating release archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
    
    if tar -czf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
        --exclude='node_modules' \
        --exclude='.git' \
        --exclude='*.tar.gz' \
        --exclude="$ARCHIVE_NAME" \
        "$SOURCE_DIR"; then
        
        print_info "Archive created successfully: $ARCHIVE_NAME"
        
        # Display archive information
        ARCHIVE_SIZE=$(du -h "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | cut -f1)
        print_info "Archive size: $ARCHIVE_SIZE"
        
        # List the contents
        print_info "Archive contents summary:"
        tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | head -20
        
        TOTAL_FILES=$(tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_NAME" | wc -l)
        print_info "Total files in archive: $TOTAL_FILES"
        
        print_info "Deployment package ready for release!"
    else
        print_error "Failed to create archive"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Show usage
show_usage() {
    echo "Usage: $0 [options]"
    echo ""
    echo "Options:"
    echo "  -h, --help       Show this help message"
    echo "  -n, --name NAME  Use custom archive name (default: release-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.tar.gz)"
    echo ""
    echo "This script creates a tar.gz archive of the current directory,"
    echo "excluding node_modules, .git directories, and other archives."
}

# Parse command line arguments
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        -h|--help)
            show_usage
            exit 0
            ;;
        -n|--name)
            ARCHIVE_NAME="$2"
            shift 2
            ;;
        *)
            print_error "Unknown option: $1"
            show_usage
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

# Run the deployment
deploy

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script - creates a release archive (.tar.gz)
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e

# Configuration
RELEASE_DIR="releases"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ENV_TEST_FILE=".env.test"
PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables
echo "=== Pre-deployment Validation ==="

if [[ ! -f "$ENV_TEST_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Error: $ENV_TEST_FILE not found!"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Checking environment variables from $ENV_TEST_FILE..."

MISSING_VARS=()

while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^# ]] && continue
    
    # Remove potential whitespace
    key=$(echo "$key" | tr -d ' ')
    
    # Check if the environment variable is set
    if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
        MISSING_VARS+=("$key")
    fi
done < "$ENV_TEST_FILE"

if [[ ${#MISSING_VARS[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo ""
    echo "Error: The following required environment variables are not set:"
    for var in "${MISSING_VARS[@]}"; do
        echo "  - $var"
    done
    echo ""
    echo "Deployment aborted."
    exit 1
fi

echo "All required environment variables are set. ✓"
echo ""

# Create releases directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "$RELEASE_DIR"

echo "Creating release archive..."
echo "Project: $PROJECT_NAME"
echo "Archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar -czf "${RELEASE_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
    --exclude="node_modules" \
    --exclude=".git" \
    --exclude="${RELEASE_DIR}" \
    --exclude="*.tar.gz" \
    .

echo ""
echo "Release archive created successfully!"
echo "Location: ${RELEASE_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "Size: $(du -h "${RELEASE_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script - creates a release archive (.tar.gz)
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e

# Configuration
RELEASE_DIR="releases"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ENV_TEST_FILE=".env.test"
ORCHESTRATOR_URL="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables
echo "=== Pre-deployment Validation ==="

if [[ ! -f "$ENV_TEST_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "Error: $ENV_TEST_FILE not found!"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Checking environment variables from $ENV_TEST_FILE..."

MISSING_VARS=()

while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^# ]] && continue
    
    # Remove potential whitespace
    key=$(echo "$key" | tr -d ' ')
    
    # Check if the environment variable is set
    if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
        MISSING_VARS+=("$key")
    fi
done < "$ENV_TEST_FILE"

if [[ ${#MISSING_VARS[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo ""
    echo "Error: The following required environment variables are not set:"
    for var in "${MISSING_VARS[@]}"; do
        echo "  - $var"
    done
    echo ""
    echo "Deployment aborted."
    exit 1
fi

echo "All required environment variables are set. ✓"
echo ""

# Send validated config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
echo "=== Sending Config to Orchestrator ==="
echo "Sending $ENV_TEST_FILE to $ORCHESTRATOR_URL..."

# Create JSON payload from .env.test file
JSON_PAYLOAD=$(jq -Rs '.' < "$ENV_TEST_FILE")

# Send POST request to orchestrator
HTTP_RESPONSE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "{\"config\": $JSON_PAYLOAD, \"project\": \"$PROJECT_NAME\", \"timestamp\": \"$TIMESTAMP\"}" \
    "$ORCHESTRATOR_URL")

HTTP_STATUS=$(echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | tail -n1)
RESPONSE_BODY=$(echo "$HTTP_RESPONSE" | sed '$d')

if [[ "$HTTP_STATUS" -ge 200 && "$HTTP_STATUS" -lt 300 ]]; then
    echo "Config sent successfully. (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)"
else
    echo "Error: Failed to send config to orchestrator. (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)"
    echo "Response: $RESPONSE_BODY"
    echo ""
    echo "Deployment aborted."
    exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "=== Creating Release Archive ==="

# Create releases directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "$RELEASE_DIR"

echo "Project: $PROJECT_NAME"
echo "Archive: $ARCHIVE_NAME"

# Create tar.gz archive excluding node_modules and .git
tar -czf "${RELEASE_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" \
    --exclude="node_modules" \
    --exclude=".git" \
    --exclude="${RELEASE_DIR}" \
    --exclude="*.tar.gz" \
    .

echo ""
echo "Release archive created successfully!"
echo "Location: ${RELEASE_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}"
echo "Size: $(du -h "${RELEASE_DIR}/${ARCHIVE_NAME}" | cut -f1)"

    local empty_vars=()

    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "Error: Environment test file '$env_file' not found" >&2
        return 1

    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    echo ""

    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do

        # Extract variable name (everything before the first =)

        # Check if variable is set in environment
        if [ -z "${!var_name+x}" ]; then
            missing_vars+=("$var_name")

            empty_vars+=("$var_name")
